blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Repair automatic combat audio causality, restore coherent authored-cemetery traversal with aligned collision and external depth, and add deterministic dense-wave performance qualification while preserving the native Godot project, host boot, and intact authored map package.

diagnosis.root_cause: Automatic lantern attack telemetry advances but the Effects bus receives no audible onset or impact events. The authored cemetery is bounded by camera-sized/support geometry whose visible perimeter reveals a dark void and whose landmark collision/visibility can drift during traversal. Dense-wave performance remains unqualified in the available runtime and needs deterministic candidate-side profiling.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, duplicate, extract, or reposition the preserved authored cemetery package.
Do not alter retained native Godot boot/project baselines or weapon component assets and transforms.
Stop audio work after bounded SEMI and quick AUTO captures prove exactly-once recognizable report and impact behavior with release/reset safety.
Stop spatial work after ordinary movement replay proves stable landmark collision/visibility and a coherent authored perimeter without void exposure.
Stop profiling after repeatable low/medium/high density samples identify frame, physics, render, and allocation behavior without new runtime errors.

strategy.rationale: Use a different root-cause treatment for each selected family: repair product-owned audio routing/envelopes around the retained attack path; restore/rebase the authoritative world datum, anchors, collision, and boundary rather than repeating camera transform tuning; and add isolated deterministic profiling for dense waves. Both active canonical issues receive direct same-loop black-box and white-box retest paths.

code: Run focused Godot parse/static checks for the audio director, lantern runtime, attack runtime, cemetery spatial contract, upgrade draft, wave director, encounter spawner, and dense profile.
Verify release-build guards exclude tester-only profile actions and instrumentation from shipped exports and that no orphaned-node or invalid-resource references are introduced.
runtime: Capture one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap with Effects audio capture; inspect mixed waveform, source-event timeline, attack-id receipts, release stop, lifecycle reset, and runtime error logs.

Replay spatial traversal from spawn through critical route, central building/landmark, and perimeter/cardinal viewpoints; inspect runtime state, collision contacts, visibility/cull stability, external depth, and boundary alignment.
Exercise one level-up draft with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/confirm paths; verify truthful current-to-new deltas and held-confirm debounce.

Run the deterministic dense-wave low/medium/high profile matrix through wave transition and reset, compare timing/render/allocation proxies, and check logs for leaks or stalls; rerun native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation checks.
visual: Use shipped gameplay screenshots for spawn, critical route, central building/landmark, and perimeter/cardinal views to confirm larger traversable scale, coherent external world depth, stable silhouettes, and no abrupt dark void.
Use a gameplay-camera level-up screenshot plus focus-state transitions to confirm silhouette-led choice hierarchy, compact deltas, readable focus states, and an unobscured arena.
Pair transient audio captures with distinct runtime time/state steps; recapture failed cells first using the same framing after edits.

done_when: A single SEMI click and a quick AUTO tap each produce exactly one bounded, recognizable firearm transient on Effects, with onset and legal-hit impact stems separately identifiable and no long ringing cue masking the report.
Automatic fire begins only on cadence-valid continuation and stops on release and lifecycle reset; generic shot VFX does not replay the complete retained player recording.
Tester can reproduce the issue with one fresh runtime audio capture and verify source-event, bus-routing, and lifecycle receipts without runtime errors.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned adapter/material-impact envelope and Effects routing around the retained automatic Warden Lantern path. Inspect the lantern runtime, attack transaction, audio director, and combat feedback presenter; isolate native report, adapter report, miss, concrete/metal/character-hit stems; deduplicate by authoritative attack id; and preserve the retained component audio and all bound weapon transforms, profiles, hierarchy, and recoil timing. Add focused receipts only to make the same-session runtime capture directly retestable.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern report and impact causality

done_when: expand the larger traversable scale so ordinary movement stays inside a coherent authored cemetery instead of exposing an abrupt dark void.
The external world has visible external depth beyond playable streets; the central building/landmark remains stable during movement replay and never disappears through camera occlusion or cull drift.

Landmark and perimeter collision align with visible geometry: no pass-through, invisible barrier, disappearance, or occlusion drift under ordinary movement; the boundary/perimeter is clearly authored and spawn lanes remain safe.

Upgrade choices encountered during the ordinary release route lead with authored weapon/upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged/placeholder rows, and expose distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states without consuming gameplay input.
Tester can replay spawn, critical route, central landmark, perimeter/cardinal views, and one level-up draft to verify spatial integrity and choice presentation.
tasks.instructions: Restore the existing intact cemetery as the sole authoritative visual world. Rebase player spawn, objective anchors, navigation/collision and playable boundary onto native authored streets/terrain; use only additive outer datum and gameplay anchors, and remove/minimize unrelated proxy/support clutter. Ensure the central building/landmark and perimeter remain visible with external world depth during ordinary movement replay. In the same ordinary release-route retest, maintain the authored upgrade-choice visual hierarchy and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus lifecycle; do not modify native child meshes or substitute PlaneMesh roads, floor patches, facades, or backdrops.
tasks.title: Restore cemetery scale, boundary, landmark collision, and choice presentation

done_when: A deterministic dense-wave profile records low, medium, and high enemy-density samples across spawn, combat, wave transition, and reset, including frame time, physics/process time, render/draw proxy, and allocation/GC measurements.

Repeated profile runs expose comparable measurements and identify the dominant cost plus a bounded optimization target if thresholds fail; instrumentation does not alter authoritative combat, wave, or lifecycle semantics.
No new runtime errors, stalls, orphan growth, or lifecycle leaks occur, and tester-only profile controls and receipts are unavailable in release exports.
Tester/Runtime can rerun the same profile matrix and compare before/after evidence without requiring a native renderer.
tasks.instructions: Extend the existing candidate-owned dense profile around the wave director, encounter spawner, combat and reset lifecycle. Add lightweight deterministic sampling for representative enemy counts and transitions, with explicit setup generation, seed, and reset-isolation receipts. Keep all instrumentation and any tester_* actions behind release-build guards; preserve gameplay timing and pooling behavior, and emit machine-readable metrics suitable for host qualification.
tasks.title: Qualify dense-wave performance with deterministic profiling
